parsed.reason: Description A says the handler lacks a return after req.reject, so execution falls through and runs the task immediately ignoring its ETA; it also notes the failure is not stored in the backend. Description B says a mark_as_failure call was removed so the failure is no longer recorded in the result backend. B's root cause (missing backend failure recording) is only a secondary point in A, while A's primary defect is the missing return causing immediate execution. These are different defects, though both touch the same error branch.
